notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been processed

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the previous entry "{}" stayed in the calendar. Delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: The call was recognized as advertising, so the appointment set during the call was cancelled: {}
notify.ap_sales_voided.note: 'sales call' rendered as an advertising call (рекламный звонок)

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same SMS is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: an SMS cannot be sent to this number, call back yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} won't suit me after all. Can we pick another time?

notify.ap_sms_off.back: will not be sent ("SMS to the caller" is turned off in settings)
notify.ap_sms_off.note: Names the setting as «SMS звонившему»; check against the real screen label

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the app on the phone is too old to send SMS

notify.ap_sms_timeout.back: the phone did not respond (time ran out)

notify.ap_sms_will.back: will be sent when you press "Accept" or "Decline"

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller never confirmed the repeated time; clarify with them before replying

notify.ap_void_failed.back: The appointment "{}" from the call was cancelled, but it could not be deleted from the calendar. Delete it yourself.

notify.ap_web_label.note: 'Confirm on the web' rendered as confirm in the browser

notify.ap_what.note: Row label 'What'; Что may read short next to an appointment title

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: number from the blacklist: a message was played, then the call was ended (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: number from the blacklist: declined while the call was ringing (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: declined while the call was ringing: nobody picked up (without AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was busy with another call and declined this one (without AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: came in during another call; the phone declined it as busy{sim}

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number to call back: the task has no contact, and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_send_failed.back: Failed to send the callback command

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: A callback is scheduled, but the phone is not currently connected to Bageo. Make sure the phone is connected to Bageo and confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The callback number is not on the white list. Add it (or the beginning of the number with an asterisk at the end) in settings and confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task sends an email, but there is no reply address. Add a contact from the transcript or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in settings and confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: Failed to pass the task to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw address and token in settings)
notify.f_openclaw_failed.note: 'token' is the OpenClaw token, translated as a normal word; check the screen label

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address looks wrong. Check it in settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address looks wrong

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in settings (it is never shown anywhere).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: The AI answered the call and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: The AI could not connect; the system hung up, the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: The AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: a refusal message was played, then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number from the blacklist: an unavailability message was played, then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud ({t}); stalling the conversation is turned off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: at first the system took the call for advertising or fraud; a second check showed an ordinary call, and the AI started speaking as usual again

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud ({t}), so the AI deliberately dragged out the conversation to take up the caller's time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system considered the call advertising or fraud, so the AI deliberately dragged out the conversation to take up the caller's time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner but could not reach them, and the AI told the caller the owner would call back soon; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out, so under "What to do" it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Quotes the to-do label Что сделать (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said the matter was urgent: the phone called the owner, who answered and was connected with the caller, and the AI left the conversation; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said the matter was urgent, and the owner was notified right away; the call was not considered advertising or fraud and the conversation was not dragged out, so under "What to do" it says: call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_transfer.note: Quotes the to-do label Что сделать (s_todo); keep them in step

notify.n_blocked.back: A number from the blacklist called

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Declined while the call was ringing: nobody picked up, the AI did not take part

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}", call ended. The AI was not used.

notify.n_named_number.note: Written as number, dash, name because the English pattern with brackets is identical in every language and trips the untranslated check

notify.n_repeat_body.back: More calls from number {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you see it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI did not connect; the system hung up after about {}, the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up]
notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.note: English has square brackets; parentheses used instead

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI did not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you know this number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the control panel

notify.s_no_service.back: The summary service is not set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary — see the transcript in the control panel.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the control panel

notify.s_stall_reply.back: The conversation was dragged out for about {}; no data was given and nothing was agreed to

notify.vm_call_back_to.back: Asks to be called back: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Asks to be called back (number not verified)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Asks to be called back at this number (confirmed by pressing 1, but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_email_to.back: Asks for a reply by email: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Asks for a reply by email (confirmed by pressing 1, but the address is unknown)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No reply method chosen (the call ended earlier)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: Message about {} long; it could not be transcribed. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voice message (could not be transcribed; needs a look)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

notify.ap_dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be a numeric date such as {}, %-d.%m, %H:%M.

notify.date_fmt.note: fixed: numeric day.month instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be a numeric day.month such as %-d.%m.

notify.dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of English month abbreviation. Month abbreviation %b is printed by the app in English (e.g. "21 Nov") inside Russian text; should be numeric such as %-d.%m, %H:%M.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. I'm listening to you.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.go_ahead.back: Yes, of course, I'm listening to you.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, hold on, I have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Needs a native check: 'постойте' must not read as a request to wait for the AI

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one little minute", "just a second", "I'll take a look now", "wait"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only the quoted local phrases, not a full instruction sentence. Whole instruction sentence ('Never say ...') instead of only the quoted phrases; the prompt inserts it after 'lines like', so it should be just "just a sec", "give me a moment", "let me see".

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have dialed is currently unavailable. Please call back later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, the courier? Fine, leave it by the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: goodbye; all the best; have a good day; see you. wrap-ups: I have to go; we'll talk later; I'll call back. ends examples: "Okay, thanks, goodbye." / "Fine, I have to go. All the best!" / "That's it, we'll talk later, see you." not_ends examples: "Hello, my name is Oleg, I'm calling about your order." / "Before you hang up, I'll tell you the main thing: we have a promotion." / "What needs to be done before the meeting so that everything goes well?"
call.speech.closing.note: Chosen only from words already in Bageo's closing list; not verified

names.aliases.back: russkiy, russkij, russian, 'Russian language' (русский язык), rus
names.aliases.note: Includes a Latin transliteration for search

app.about_dedicated.back: In AI mode the module takes over the calling app, mutes the ringing and turns on Do Not Disturb, so a spare phone works best. To temporarily use the phone as usual, turn off the switch at the top.

app.about_legal.back: Laws about recording calls and about the duty to tell callers they are talking to an AI depend on location. Complying with them is your responsibility.

app.about_rollback.back: To remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (the phone becomes ordinary again), then disable or delete the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.

app.agent_url_label.note: Source says 'Agent address'; written as 'Bageo address' because the glossary avoids 'agent'

app.btn_reset_usb.note: Fixed by the manager per the back-translation note.

app.btn_set.note: Button next to a setup step; 'Assign' (as the default app)

app.check_priv_missing.back: Installed as a regular app (%1$s). Install the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone. If you installed the APK manually, delete this copy.

app.check_priv_title.back: Installed as a privileged system app

app.check_privperm_desc.back: Granted by the module at boot. They cannot be granted on this screen.

app.check_uplink_idle.back: Not visible right now. On some phones it appears only during a call; if the AI's voice does not go into the call, the app will tell you.

app.check_uplink_missing.back: A module is needed: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing.

app.check_uplink_title.back: Feeding the AI's voice into the call

app.confirm_ai_body.back: This phone will become a phone answered by AI: calls will no longer ring, the AI picks up. Google's Phone app is disabled and Do Not Disturb is turned on.
app.confirm_ai_body.note: 'Google Phone' written as the Google Phone app «Телефон» от Google

app.confirm_normal_body.back: Calls will ring and you will answer them yourself. The AI will no longer answer calls on this phone.

app.connection_hint_usb.back: USB (default, recommended): leave ws://127.0.0.1:8765. The program on the computer forwards this port itself over the USB cable via adb reverse.

app.connection_hint_wifi.back: Wi-Fi: enter the address shown by the program on the computer, for example ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and computer must be on the same network.

app.grant_perms.back: Grant the requested permissions and tap "Start the service" again.

app.header_compat.back: Tested on Pixel 7, 7a, 8 and 9. It may work on other rooted phones; try at your own risk.

app.ip_addr_label.back: IP address of the Bageo program

app.ip_code_hint.back: The code is on the "System" page of the control panel

app.ip_err_address.back: Enter the IP address of Bageo, for example 192.168.1.20.

app.ip_err_busy.back: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.

app.ip_err_code.back: The pairing code is wrong or expired. Get a new one in the control panel.

app.ip_err_code_format.back: The pairing code consists of 6 digits.

app.ip_err_unreachable.back: This address is unreachable. Make sure the phone and Bageo are on the same network.

app.ip_err_wifi_off.back: First turn on the "Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi" option in the control panel.
app.ip_err_wifi_off.note: Quotes a console setting label; check against the real Russian console label

app.mode_err_busy.back: The previous switch has not finished yet.

app.mode_err_dialer.back: Could not change the default calling app.

app.mode_err_dnd.back: Could not change the Do Not Disturb mode.

app.mode_err_dnd_mode.back: Do Not Disturb is still on. On the phone open "Settings" → "Modes" and turn off "%1$s".

app.mode_err_in_call.back: A call is in progress; hang up first.

app.mode_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module is not working. In Magisk or KernelSU check that the Bageo Uplink module is enabled, and restart the phone.

app.mode_err_screening.back: Could not change the call screening setting.

app.mode_err_volume.back: Could not set the call volume.

app.mode_failed.back: The switch did not complete. %1$s You can try again.

app.mode_switch_hint.back: Turn off to use the phone as an ordinary one: calls ring and you answer yourself.

app.msg_no_browser.back: This phone has no app that opens web pages.

app.msg_perm_settings.back: Some permissions can no longer be requested here. Grant them on the app's system settings page.

app.msg_url_invalid.back: The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and contain a host.

app.msg_url_saved_pending.back: Saved. To apply the new address, tap "Stop the service" and then "Start the service" when there is no call.

app.msg_url_saved_restarted.back: Saved. The service was restarted to apply the new address.

app.msg_wifi_forgotten.back: The Wi-Fi connection is forgotten. To set it up again, connect the USB cable once.

app.notification_text_armed.back: Ready. Waiting for calls; the phone is silent.

app.notification_text_in_call.back: The AI is handling the conversation.

app.notification_text_normal.back: Regular phone: calls ring, you answer yourself.

app.perm_answer_calls.back: Answer calls: automatically pick up and hang up

app.perm_modify_phone_state.back: Feeding the AI's voice into the call

app.perm_read_call_log.back: Call log: read the caller's number

app.perm_read_phone_state.back: Phone: know when a call started and ended

app.route_custom.back: Connected via the address you entered.

app.st_ai_on_d.back: The AI takes incoming calls. The phone is silent.

app.st_legacy_off.back: The former "AI answers" switch on this phone was off. After this update the switch above decides: now the AI answers here. Turn it off to keep the phone ordinary.
app.st_legacy_off.note: Refers to the old switch label; check against the real label

app.st_normal.back: Regular phone: calls ring as usual

app.st_normal_d.back: The AI does not answer. You answer calls yourself, like on any phone. Turn on the switch below so the AI answers again.

app.st_offline.back: No connection to the computer yet

app.st_offline_d.back: Check that Bageo is running on the computer and the phone is connected by USB or is on the same Wi-Fi network (first connect once by USB for pairing).

app.st_service_off.back: The answering service is not running

app.st_service_off_d.back: Tap "Start" to turn it on again.

app.st_steps_d.back: Complete the setup steps below so the AI can answer calls.

app.st_switching_d.back: This usually takes a few seconds.

app.step_battery_desc.back: Stops Android from closing Bageo to save battery, so you do not miss a call.

app.step_battery_title.back: Do not let Android put Bageo to sleep

app.step_dialer_desc.back: So that the phone does not show the call screen while the AI is talking.

app.step_dialer_title.back: Make Bageo the default calling app

app.step_dnd_desc.back: The phone is silent while the AI is answering.

app.step_dnd_title.back: Allow Bageo to control Do Not Disturb

app.step_module_missing.back: Install the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.

app.step_pair_ip.back: Cannot connect USB (for example, Bageo runs in Docker): get a pairing code in the control panel and tap "Connect by IP address".

app.step_pair_missing.back: First time: turn on USB debugging and connect the phone to the computer where Bageo runs. After one pairing it connects over Wi-Fi too.

app.step_pair_ok.back: Paired with the computer. Calls work over Wi-Fi and without a cable.

app.step_pair_title.back: Connect to the computer by USB for pairing

app.step_perms_desc.back: Needed to notice calls, pick up, and pass the call audio to the computer.

app.step_perms_title.back: Allow Bageo access to the phone and microphone

app.step_screening_desc.back: So that incoming calls do not ring.

app.step_screening_title.back: Make Bageo the call screening app

app.test_fail_auth.back: denied: the address has no token or it is wrong

app.test_fail_network.back: this address is unreachable. Are the phone and computer on the same network?

app.test_fail_refused.back: the computer refused the connection. Is Bageo running there, and is the USB link set up?

app.test_fail_rejected.back: someone answered, but it is not Bageo or it rejected the connection

app.test_fail_tls.back: could not establish a secure connection (wss)

app.uplink_missing_text.back: The call audio channel is unavailable. Make sure the Bageo module is installed and enabled, then restart the phone.

app.uplink_missing_title.back: The caller cannot hear the AI

app.wifi_not_ready.back: The backup Wi-Fi connection is not set up. Connect the USB cable once to set it up.

app.wifi_ready.back: The backup Wi-Fi connection is ready. Calls will keep working if you unplug the USB cable.

desktop.adb_failed.back: Could not download. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: Android tools (about 7 MB, from Google) are needed for phones over USB.

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Could not save some settings. Try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to see your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Connect a phone and open the app. It will appear here.

desktop.r_all_normal.back: All phones work as regular ones

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo did not start. See bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: No connection to Bageo. Is it still running?

desktop.r_phone_offline.note: Reworded to 'No connection: {name}' to avoid gender agreement with the phone name

desktop.r_setup.note: Plural form avoided by using 'Осталось заполнить настроек: {n}'

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave empty to find it automatically.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: For this to work, update Bageo and the SMS forwarding program.

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When the call summary is ready

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Needed only if your control panel has a password.

console.discard.note: «Отменить» is identical to undo and er_cancel_q; acceptable, «Не сохранять» would be clearer.

console.k_voicemail.note: fixed: same term as the other voicemail labels

console.ap_reply.note: 'Tell them by' became «Способ ответа» (reply method); acceptable.

console.ap_call_not_callable.note: «заграница» is a place, not a number type in the list; «международный» would read better. Same in f_appt_reply_h.

console.tr_listen.note: «Оба» alone is a little odd as a tab label; «Оба голоса» is clearer. Meaning right.

console.tr_vm.note: «Голосовое сообщение» fits the message the caller left, but k_voicemail and er_oc_voicemail use «голосовая почта» for the same English word; consider aligning.

console.d_copy_link.note: «URL» is a bit technical; «Копировать ссылку» is plainer. Meaning right.

console.d_scam.note: fixed: same term as f_spam and k_spam

console.ct_delete_title.note: {name} stays in the nominative: «Удалить Алексей?» is grammatically off for a name; «Удалить контакт «{name}»?» is safer. Same issue in sms_del_thread_t, ct_imp_dup, ct_imp_dup_name, er_id_assistant, er_fu_h. Meaning right.

console.ct_imp_dup.note: {name} after «у» should be genitive; «…что у контакта: {name}» is safer. Meaning right.

console.ct_imp_dup_name.note: {name} after «у» should be genitive; «То же имя, что у контакта: {name}» is safer. Meaning right.

console.f_owner_aliases_h.note: 'An English name' became «Иностранное имя» (foreign name); acceptable adaptation.

console.f_style.note: 'Answer style' became «Роль при ответе» (role); matches the options (assistant / as me). Acceptable.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key on the Google AI Studio website

console.vc_breathy.note: «придыхание» is a noun while the other voice words are adjectives; «с придыханием» reads better. Meaning right.

console.vc_casual.note: «простой» means simple; «непринуждённый» or «неформальный» is closer to 'casual' (vc_easy_going already uses «непринуждённый»).

console.f_stall_max.note: «Макс. длина» differs from «Макс. длительность» in f_normal_max for the same kind of setting; «Макс. длительность такого звонка» is better.

console.f_knowledge_ph.note: English example has two lines (one fact per line); here both facts are on one line. Acceptable.

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat are taken from the environment variables TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. The variable TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS restricts the list of users allowed to send commands.

console.mcp_desc.note: 'to-dos' became «задачи» while n_ctl_h uses the list name «Что сделать»; acceptable.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL) or the bot token and channel ID; one of them is enough. For private messages put your own ID instead of the channel ID. Commands: fill in the bot token and channel ID and turn on Message Content Intent.
console.hint_discord.note: fixed: added that one of the two is enough

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an incoming webhook URL (also for Mattermost) or fill in the bot token and channel ID; one of them is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, fill in the bot token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.
console.hint_slack.note: fixed: added that one of the two is enough

console.hint_line.note: Last clause 'this replaces it' (LINE Notify) is dropped; acceptable but could be added.

console.hint_ntfy.note: 'hard to guess' became «сложную» (complicated) and 'topic' became «тему» while the field says «Topic»; «название темы, которое трудно угадать» is better.

console.hint_ifttt.back: The key is shown on ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation. Create an applet "If Webhooks: web request received" with the same event name; value1 is the title, value2 is the text.

console.f_appt_reply_h.note: «заграница» in a list of number types; «международные» would read better.

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: Could not play the AI audio, switched to voicemail

console.nf_line_token.note: Kept in English as the LINE field name (allowed by the glossary) while hint_line says «токен доступа к каналу»; acceptable.

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: The SMS cannot be sent again: no decision has been made on the appointment yet or the SMS was already sent.

console.ph_to_ai.back: Turn the AI answering back on

console.ph_to_normal_b.note: 'someone has to pick up' became 'until you pick up'; acceptable.

console.er_task_ph.note: English puts the second example on a new line after 'or:'; here both are inline. Acceptable.

console.er_id_assistant.note: «Помощник {name}» wants the genitive of the name; «Помощник: {name}» is safer. Meaning right.

console.er_fu_h.note: «позвонит {who}» wants the dative of the name; consider «…по этому поручению: {who}». Meaning right.

console.f_wl_mode.note: fixed: not translation or money transfer

console.sms_del_thread_t.note: {name} stays in the nominative after «с»; «Удалить переписку: {name}?» is safer. Meaning right.

console.lang_unreviewed_note.back: This language has not been checked by a native speaker yet.
